title: Opencode TUI plugin: sidebar Jira-like ticket view
objective: Build an opencode v2 TUI plugin that renders the current ticketing context in the sidebar — active ticket with phased todo list, related ticket statuses, and an expandable board view (all tickets and context-filtered). The plugin auto-detects which tickets the agent is working on from the opencode session context and filters accordingly.

comments.author: cli
comments.body: Promoted from the stray store at little-mester-mcp/docs/tickets/ticket-001.json, created 2026-10-26T15:52 by the old cwd-relative CLI wrapper. This is an earlier, thinner draft of the TUI plugin idea; ticket #33 is the fuller version with the Create button and acceptance criteria.

acceptance_criteria.text: The sidebar renders the current ticket and its phased todo list.
Related ticket statuses are visible alongside the active ticket.
The board view expands to all tickets, with context filtering.
The plugin auto-detects active tickets from the opencode session context.
